HomeCinema.MovieNight.Catalog.CatalogRea.report: src/persistence.rs derives film summaries, details and overviews from stored films, ratings, polls and votes. The public service requests those projections through Ports, without exposing Connection or SQL to callers.
limitations: Authored source inspection with selected finite native evidence; no exhaustive input, branch or architecture proof.

HomeCinema.MovieNight.Community.MutableR.report: The ratings table has PRIMARY KEY(film_id,member_id). Store::put uses ON CONFLICT to replace the document. rating_summary counts the current rows and computes their average; changing a rating does not add a second rating.
limitations: Authored source inspection with selected finite native evidence; no exhaustive input, branch or architecture proof.

HomeCinema.MovieNight.ScreeningPlanning..report: The votes table has PRIMARY KEY(poll_id,member_id). Store::put updates both film_id and document on conflict. Casting a changed vote replaces that member/poll row and overview recounts actual persisted rows.
limitations: Authored source inspection with selected finite native evidence; no exhaustive input, branch or architecture proof.

HomeCinema.MovieNight.ScreeningPlanning..report: domain::candidate_order_winner scans candidates in order, counts their matching votes and replaces the winner only on a strictly larger positive count. Unknown films do not count and empty/all-zero inputs yield null.
